title: API: a part id from another location or organization fails with Part not found and is left unchanged
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com, S2 shop. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. API replay from Chrome DevTools against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location (Copy as fetch from a request of the logged-in session, then edit method, path and body). QAPL-LK1 is stocked at Staging Lethbridge only; QAPL-B1 is active at both locations. A part id from another organization: any part of a different QA organization the tester can open on this env (skip step 5 if none is available and note it in the result).
custom_steps:
1. With X-Location-ID = Staging Lethbridge: GET /api/inventory/parts?status=active&search=QAPL-LK1, then search=QAPL-B1; note both ids.
  2. With X-Location-ID = Staging Heavy Duty: PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status with body {"partIds":["<QAPL-LK1 id>","<QAPL-B1 Lethbridge id>"],"status":"inactive","note":"QA scope"}.
  3. With X-Location-ID = Staging Lethbridge: repeat the two GETs from step 1, then open both parts' Part History at Staging Lethbridge.
  4. In the app at Staging Heavy Duty search QAPL-B1 on the Active tab.
  5. With X-Location-ID = Staging Heavy Duty: PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status with body {"partIds":["<other organization part id>"],"status":"inactive","note":"QA scope"}, then check that part in its own organization.
custom_expected:
1. 200; both parts are listed with is_active: true.
  2. 200; data.updated is []; data.failed lists both ids with "Part not found." and partNumber: null.
  3. Both parts are still listed with is_active: true; neither Part History has a "Deactivated | Reason: QA scope" entry.
  4. QAPL-B1 is still on the Active tab at Staging Heavy Duty (not part of this change).
  5. 200; data.failed lists the id with "Part not found." and partNumber: null; the part is still active in its own organization with no new history entry.
